name: bi-delivery
description: Multi-stage Antigravity Power BI engineering workflow orchestrating G1 design validation, optional semantic model & PBIR delivery, parallel specialist hygiene/governance audits, and G1-G7 evidence-gated release.

requirement_path.description: Relative or absolute path to the requirement YAML contract.

mode.description: deliver runs end-to-end model/report authoring + G1-G7 verification; audit runs G1 + parallel specialist audits without mutating artifacts.

auto_commit.description: When mode=deliver and all 7 gates pass, run bi-agent git-commit.

allow_main.description: Allow committing directly on main/master when auto_commit is true.
